site.name: lattice
site.summary: lattice-clone Fictional hosted columnar / relational database "Lattice DB" marketing site, centered on the two-dimensional matrix on the pricing page. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Short landing: technical paragraph + SQL code example + 3 features + CTA | | `pricing.html` | Main page: 6 rows (seats) × 6 columns (data volume) two-dimensional matrix; clicking a cell highlights the row and column and updates the right-side sticky quote card (with a "How this is calculated" expansion); 9 add-on checkboxes (percentage or flat add-on); bottom final monthly-fee breakdown card; 4-tier explainer (clicking a cell auto-highlights the corresponding tier); 15-row feature comparison; 8-question FAQ; footer | | `styles.css` | Brand color #6D28D9 purple; IBM Plex Sans + Mono; responsive |

run_plan.goal: Exhaustively explore and critique the UX of the Lattice DB site, focusing on the complex two-dimensional pricing matrix, add-on calculations, and responsive layout behaviors.
run_plan.summary: The run will start by validating the landing page and its navigation, then move deeply into the pricing page's core matrix interaction and quote card updates. It will systematically test all add-on checkboxes and the calculation breakdown, followed by validating the tier explainer and feature matrix. Finally, it will assess mobile responsiveness and layout warnings across both pages.
assumptions: The pricing matrix cells are clickable and trigger JavaScript to update the sticky quote card.
The 9 add-on checkboxes dynamically alter the final monthly fee breakdown.
The 'How this is calculated' expansion and FAQ sections are interactive and functional.
Navigation links like Docs, Customers, and Sign in point to '#' and will not navigate away from the site.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html: 6x6 matrix cell selection and corresponding sticky quote card state synchronization
pricing.html: Accurate mathematical calculation updates when combining percentage and flat-fee add-ons
pricing.html: Mobile responsiveness of the large pricing matrix and sticky quote card
index.html: Small tap targets for navigation links on mobile viewports

phases.title: Landing Page Validation
phases.objective: Verify the structure, content, and navigation of the landing page before proceeding to the primary flow.
key_checks: Verify all headings and the SQL code block render correctly
Click the 'See pricing' CTA and confirm navigation to pricing.html
Click top navigation links (Platform, Pricing, Docs, Customers, Sign in, Book demo) and verify behavior

phases.title: Pricing Matrix Core Flow
phases.objective: Validate the primary two-dimensional pricing matrix interactions and the sticky quote card updates.
key_checks: Click cells across different rows (seats) and columns (data volume)
Verify the sticky quote card updates with the correct base price
Verify the 'Contact us' cells behave appropriately (no price update, possible modal or text change)
Click the 'How we got this number' / 'How this is calculated' expansion and verify content
exit_criteria: At least 5 different matrix cells selected
Quote card accurately reflects selected cell
Calculation expansion opens and closes correctly

phases.title: Add-ons and Breakdown
phases.objective: Test the 9 add-on checkboxes and ensure the final monthly-fee breakdown card calculates correctly.
key_checks: Toggle percentage-based add-ons (e.g., Continuous cross-region backups +15%)
Toggle flat-fee add-ons (e.g., HIPAA compliance pack +$400/mo)
Verify the bottom final monthly-fee breakdown card updates with correct sums
Test combining multiple add-ons to check for calculation errors

phases.title: Tiers and Feature Comparison
phases.objective: Validate the 4-tier explainer synchronization and the 15-row feature comparison matrix.
key_checks: Select a matrix cell and verify the corresponding tier (Developer, Team, Scale, Enterprise) auto-highlights
Click through tier explainer sections
Scroll through and verify the 15-row feature comparison matrix aligns with tiers
exit_criteria: Tier highlighting matches selected matrix cell
Feature matrix reviewed for layout and content integrity

phases.title: FAQ and Footer
phases.objective: Ensure the 8-question FAQ section is interactive and the footer is well-structured.
key_checks: Expand and collapse multiple FAQ items
Verify FAQ content is legible and doesn't break layout
Check footer links and content

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks on a mobile viewport to validate responsive design and address layout warnings.
key_checks: Verify mobile navigation menu (if exists) or horizontal scrolling behavior
Test pricing matrix interaction on mobile viewport
Verify sticky quote card positioning and readability on mobile
Re-validate small tap targets identified in prescan (nav links)
exit_criteria: Mobile viewport tested on both pages
Matrix and quote card interactions functional on mobile

coverage_targets.features: exercise all 36 matrix cells conceptually (test at least 5 distinct cells), all 9 add-ons, FAQ, tier explainer, and feature matrix

prescan_summary.title: Lattice DB — Analytics database
prescan_summary.visible_text_excerpt: Lattice DB Platform Pricing Docs Customers Sign in Book demo The relational column-store for teams that want both axes priced honestly. Lattice DB combines a Postgres-compatible API with a Parquet-backed analytical engine. Mix transactional and analytical workloads without a separate warehouse. SELECT region, sum(revenue) AS r FROM orders JOIN customers USING (customer_id) WHERE order_date >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY region ORDER BY r DESC; Postgres wire Drop in any pg client. We speak the protocol. Columnar under the hood Vectorized execution. Late materialization. Zone maps. Pay for the cell you live in Pricing on team size × data size. No phantom add-ons. See pricing Local demo for UXBench. Fictional product, not a real company.
headings: The relational column-store for teams that want both axes priced honestly.
Pay for the cell you live in
